bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are prohibited; the venue FAQ does not specify a numeric limit for other bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: A parking lot is 0.1 mile south at Cameron and Main; street spaces in the Tulsa Arts District are free after 5 p.m. and on weekends.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ describes parking but does not specify a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Full bars serve beer and spirits, concessions have soft drinks and Mac’s BBQ serves food during shows. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: There is no designated accessible seating area; contact the venue at least 72 hours in advance to discuss accommodation. Mezzanine access requires stairs.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is allowed, except for an emergency.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Pick up Will Call tickets while the box office is open; bring photo ID, confirmation number and the purchasing card. It opens Wednesdays and Fridays 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and roughly 30 minutes before doors on show nights.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Check the specific ticket for its door time; there is no indoor waiting area before doors open.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
